remarks: This East Norwalk location truly delivers. Walk to water! Commuter friendly being within walking distance to East Norwalk/South Norwalk Train Stations & I95 (Exit 16). Just across the street from the popular Veterans Park (Oyster Festival) & the L.I Sound. A quick walk over the bridge and you can enjoy all that SONO has to offer. The unit itself has been beautifully renovated with meticulous upgrades to the kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, appliances & MORE! Spacious living room facing the Sound is breathtaking. Plenty of closet space. This first floor three bedroom, 2 full bath apt has tons of natural light, storage space & 2 garage spots to make you feel completely comfortable. Outdoor space in rear for grilling, PERFECT for a BBQ! Plenty of parking for guests on Seaview or Betts Pl. Watch the 4th of July fireworks from home! Natural gas for heat, hot water & cooking + erergy efficient windows, insulation keep the utilities LOW! Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references. Pet restrictions/No smoking. Tenants can request washer/dryer in unit for additional $150/month. Current laundry/storage in basement. *New pics to follow*
